description:
Generate a 'Menu Usage' report in Floreant POS and export it as a PDF file.

1. Go to the Back Office (PIN: 1111).
2. Navigate to the Reports section.
3. Select the 'Menu Usage' report (sometimes labeled 'Product Mix' or 'Item Sales').
4. Run the report for 'All Time' or the default period.
5. Export the report as a PDF file.
6. Save the file to '/home/ga/Desktop/menu_usage.pdf'.
